question.text: The decay of a proton to neutron is :

options.text: not possible as proton mass is less than the neutron mass
not possible but neutron to proton conversion is possible
always possible as it is associated only with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>β</mi><mo>+</mo></msup></math> decay

solution.text: It is possible only inside the nucleus and not otherwise as it can not decay to a state of greater mass. Inside a nucleus however, the situation is different, as the binding energy of a nucleus provides the necessary energy to compensate for the neutron-proton mass difference.
